title: User response to a SOC report
html:
User response to a SOC report

Evaluate the report and management responses before relying on an outsourced service.

Required responses

fields.label: Response to delayed access removal

options.value: Evaluate relevance and adjust the user’s risk response
options.label: Evaluate relevance and adjust the user’s risk response

options.value: Ignore every exception in an issued report
options.label: Ignore every exception in an issued report

options.value: Assume all user controls are tested
options.label: Assume all user controls are tested

options.value: Treat the report as a universal guarantee
options.label: Treat the report as a universal guarantee

fields.correct: Evaluate relevance and adjust the user’s risk response
fields.explanation: Exceptions need to be considered in the user’s context.

fields.label: Nature of the description omission

options.value: A known description issue requiring conclusion evaluation
options.label: A known description issue requiring conclusion evaluation

options.value: Only a cosmetic problem in every case
options.label: Only a cosmetic problem in every case

fields.correct: A known description issue requiring conclusion evaluation
fields.explanation: A material omission may affect fair presentation.

fields.label: Nature of unavailable control evidence

options.value: Automatic proof of every possible failure
options.label: Automatic proof of every possible failure

fields.explanation: Missing evidence affects the basis for a conclusion.

fields.label: Treatment of the remediation promise

options.value: Seek evidence of implementation and effectiveness
options.label: Seek evidence of implementation and effectiveness

options.value: Treat the promise as completed remediation
options.label: Treat the promise as completed remediation

fields.correct: Seek evidence of implementation and effectiveness
fields.explanation: A future plan is not operating evidence.

exhibits.title: Report findings
exhibits.html: The report identifies delayed privileged-access removal. A material service process is omitted from the description. Evidence for another control is unavailable.

exhibits.title: Provider response
exhibits.html: The provider promises a new access process next quarter but provides no implementation or testing evidence.
